examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The Blog list at rest, with the default `category-search` filter bar. Pick a category or type in the search field to narrow it; when nothing matches, the list and its button are left out. WebKit ships no editorial media, so the covers here are the neutral `@aziontech/webkit/assets/placeholder-image.svg`; pass your own image URLs.

examples.name: Facets
examples.summary: The Resource Hub list at rest, with `filters="facets"`: one dropdown per facet, rows in the centered layout. Pick a value in a dropdown to narrow it; the dropdowns combine, and when nothing matches the list and its button are left out.

examples.name: Empty
examples.summary: A list whose filters match nothing renders the empty state (`emptyTitle`): a search icon, its title and description, and an action that clears the category and the search. Type in the search field to see it; the action brings the list back.
